name: pi
summary: 开源的终端编程 agent（pi-mono）：查看会话、状态和完整对话；在 tmux（Mac、Linux）、终端窗口（Windows）中运行，或由 Kiteline 在后台运行时可回复和中断
summaryEn: Open-source terminal coding agent (pi-mono): view sessions, status and full conversations; reply and interrupt when it runs in tmux (Mac, Linux), a terminal window (Windows) or in the background through Kiteline

cli.note: 回复和中断需要 pi 在 tmux 中运行，或在 Kiteline 新建任务时选它（后台运行）
在终端窗口中运行即可回复和中断
回复和中断需要 pi 在 tmux 中运行，或在 Kiteline 新建任务时选它（后台运行）

limitsNote: pi 不在本机记录订阅额度，也没有提供查询接口，「今日用量」中不显示；token 和花费按 pi 自己的记录统计（花费按 pi 内置的价目表计算，自定义模型服务不计花费）
limitsNoteEn: pi doesn't record plan quotas on your computer and offers no way to query them, so they aren't shown under Today's usage; tokens and cost come from pi's own records (cost uses pi's built-in price list; custom model providers have no cost)
speaker: pi
notes: 首个版本：查看 pi 的会话和完整对话，在 tmux 中运行时可从手机回复、中断和关闭会话。
notesEn: First release: view pi sessions and full conversations; reply, interrupt and close sessions from your phone when pi runs in tmux.

gaps.text: 没有确认和回答提问：pi 本身不弹权限确认框、也没有提问工具（官方的设计，需要的话由 pi 的扩展自己实现）
gaps.textEn: No confirming or answering questions: pi itself never asks for permission and has no question tool (by design; extensions can add them)

gaps.text: 从手机发的图片以文件路径随消息发送，由 pi 用读文件工具查看：pi 的终端界面只能从剪贴板贴图
gaps.textEn: Images sent from your phone go with the message as file paths for pi to open with its read tool: pi's terminal interface only accepts images pasted from the clipboard

gaps.text: 刚启动、还没发第一句的会话先显示为「新会话」，发出第一句后显示完整记录：pi 在第一句发出后才写会话文件
gaps.textEn: A session that hasn't received its first message shows as "New session" until then: pi only writes the session file after the first message

gaps.text: 没有用真实的模型服务账号实测（用 pi 的自定义模型配置接测试服务测的）
gaps.textEn: Not tested with a real model provider account (tested through pi's custom model setting)
